newsitem.title: USA: Voice Powered sees continued difficulties.
newsitem.headline: Voice Powered sees continued difficulties.

text.p: Voice Powered Technology International Inc said Monday that it has not filed its Form 10-KSB, which was due April 15, with the Securities and Exchange Commission.
The company said it missed the deadline because of its financial difficulties, which it said may affect its abilities to continue as a going concern.
The company, which designs and develops voice recognition consumer products, was delisted from Nasdaq earlier this month.
It has so far been unable to complete proposed business combinations with other companies. Most recently Franklin Electronic Publishers Inc ended its proposed acquisition of the company.
